body:
Schema design inconsistency: FilePersistenceConfigSchema sets a default value for autoSaveInterval (line 61: `.default(2000)`), but AutoPersistenceConfigSchema does not set this default (line 102: `.optional()` without default). While this works at runtime because FileSystemPersistenceAdapter has its own fallback (line 23 in file-adapter.ts), it creates an inconsistency in the schema layer.

Consider adding `.default(2000)` to line 102 for consistency with FilePersistenceConfigSchema, or document why the default is intentionally omitted for the auto config.
```suggestion
  /** Auto-save interval override when running in Node.js. Defaults to 2000ms (consistent with file persistence). */
  autoSaveInterval: z.number().min(100).default(2000).describe('Auto-save interval override for Node.js environments'),
```
